title: Alert Dialog
description: Asks the shopper to confirm or cancel an action before it happens, such as removing an address, and keeps focus inside until they choose.

components.AlertDialog: Groups all parts of the alert dialog.
components.AlertDialogAction: Confirms the action the dialog asks about and closes the dialog.
components.AlertDialogCancel: Dismisses the dialog without taking the action.
components.AlertDialogContent: Holds what the alert dialog shows while open.
components.AlertDialogDescription: Explains what the action in the dialog will do.
components.AlertDialogFooter: Holds the cancel and confirm buttons at the bottom of the dialog.
components.AlertDialogHeader: Groups the title and description at the top of the dialog.
components.AlertDialogMedia: Holds an icon or image that illustrates the dialog.
components.AlertDialogTitle: Names the action the dialog asks the user to confirm.
